name: Entina (ENTINA3D)
summary: Beginner 3D-printer brand (Tina2 / Tina2C / Tina2S / Tina2 Plus) that sells companion PLA in small-spool bundles: basic PLA 4-colour sets, 250 g high-speed PLA and 4 x 200 g silk PLA. Effective per-kg prices are high because of the mini-spool format. The legal entity is unconfirmed.

product_lines.name: PLA Basic / Standard bundles
product_lines.notes: 4-colour bundles of small spools (4 x 50 g and 200 g sets); about $180/kg effective.

product_lines.name: Silk PLA bundle
product_lines.notes: 4 x 200 g per site title (tracker says 4 x 50 g), $36-37.

additional_notes: Printer maker first, not a bulk-filament brand; also sells Tina2/Tina2C starter bundles. The site shows a US phone number (+1 206 797 6097) and only '© ENTINA' in the footer. Filament origin unknown and no relationship recorded. Deal-tracker pack sizes are inconsistent with listing titles.

provenance.conflicts: Possible legal entity MINGAO LIMITED (Hong Kong) comes from a single techgearlab snippet and is uncorroborated; Newegg calls the seller China-based, while the site lists a US phone number. headquarters_country is therefore omitted.
